description: What x402 API should I build? The demand gap finder runs up to 150 Bazaar searches phrased the way buyer agents phrase tasks and ranks the unmet demand: tasks whose top results are weak (no listings, few payers, thin descriptions or a poor fit), with the evidence for each, a spec per gap (an OpenAPI skeleton, a Fair Offer block and a price from the category price index) and the gap's trend week over week. Public Bazaar data only, joined with measured repeat demand per category. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

ticket.description: Optional: true to get a ticket instead of waiting. The run then has minutes instead of 85 s and waits for a busy slot; the paid answer is the ticket, and its result is free with the job_status tool.
